title: [29.x] Reversed output entry stays uninvoiced (Invoiced Quantity = 0) after reopening a finished production order, causing quantity discrepancy in Inventory Valuation
summary: Reversed output entries now correctly maintain their invoiced quantity when a finished production order is reopened, preventing quantity discrepancies in inventory valuation.
key_points: Fixes incorrect handling of reversed output entries during production order reopening
Ensures invoiced quantity remains properly set instead of becoming zero
Prevents inventory quantity discrepancies in valuation reports
Changes applied to inventory adjustment calculation logic
Test coverage added to verify the fix
